minutes.headline: Board passed on buying a Route 2A parcel and added a Town Meeting article to abate taxes on a donated Chase Road parcel
minutes.summary: The board met at the high school. It voted to add a Special Town Meeting article to abate back taxes on a donated conservation parcel, and voted to pass on the right of first refusal for a Chapter 61B parcel. It discussed the turf field revolving fund and who controls the field, heard the first-quarter financial report, and planned building workshops. It made two appointments and adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to add a Special Town Meeting article to abate back taxes on a donated Chase Road conservation parcel.
The board voted to pass on the right of first refusal for a Chapter 61B parcel on Route 2A.
The board discussed the turf field revolving fund and field control; no resolution, with the school committee and parks invited back November 21st.
The finance director gave the first-quarter FY18 report; new growth came in above estimate, leaving unappropriated levy capacity.
The board appointed members to the Worcester County Selectmen's Association; the vote on the Finance Committee representative was not audible.

why_it_matters: The Chase Road abatement means back taxes on the donated parcel would be absorbed by the overlay, a reserve funded by the tax levy, and voters will be asked to approve it at Special Town Meeting.
Higher-than-estimated new growth creates levy capacity that Town Meeting could be asked to spend, and the turf field's funding and control remain unsettled before articles reach the floor.
watch_next: November 9th: Finance Committee hearing, with a well-developed plan for the new growth money due beforehand.
November 21st: school committee and parks to attend on the turf field; facilities discussion also on the November 7th and 21st agendas.
